description: Idrees Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 5 June 1990 and listed in April 1992; its principal activity is the manufacture and sale of yarn and fabric. It runs two divisions presented on its site — spinning, producing a range of cotton, polyester-cotton, viscose, modal, Tencel, slub and Siro yarns, and home textiles. The mill is at Kot Shah Mohammad, Tehsil and District Nankana in Punjab, and the registered office is in Bahadurabad, Karachi.
headOffice: 6-C, Ismail Centre, 1st Floor, Central Commercial Area, Bahadurabad, Karachi, Pakistan
